items.guidance: Find the run script of each s6 service under the docker directory: svc-web becomes the image default command, svc-workers becomes a declared worker with the same command. init-db-migration is a one-time step, not a long-running program; report its command as the release migration command instead of a worker. Keep the s6 files for the existing single-container install.

Search the Next.js API routes for an existing health or status route that does not require a session. If you add one, use a route handler that returns 200 without database access, and if a Next.js middleware file enforces login or redirects, exclude only this path in its matcher.

Check the database package that uses better-sqlite3 for an ORM dialect or a setting that selects PostgreSQL, such as a DATABASE_URL or a database type variable. Report the setting if it exists; otherwise report that the data layer uses SQLite only, and that the init-db-migration step also targets that SQLite file.
